checked_facts.fact: Source configurations include separate Ichgahal and Murcion centres and spectator rectangles.

Bloodjaw target uses max(persisted taints or zero, active CONDITION_BAKRAGORE subid or zero) over same-floor players within 15 of the configured centre; target thresholds are 5, 8 and 9, capped at five bloodjaws.
Current bloodjaw population is counted within 15 of the current boss; paused Game storage equal to one suppresses spawning.
Mechanics-disabled state is a per-boss script table flag; an absent state returns false.

implementation_note: This retained source is evidence for the remaining native room integration. The existing Quest model regular-taint counter is not assumed to equal an active Bakragore-condition subid.
